purpose: Teach: 眉/ポテト/茹で/間取り/スイカ/ありのまま/体型/嫌う

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの眉、お父さんに、似てるって、お祖父ちゃんに、言われたよ。
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa told me I have Dad's eyebrows.
lines.style: Soft, wondering delivery. Sho is sharing a small discovery, proud but not sure if it matters. Light, conversational pace. Slight pause before 'Dad's eyebrows' — he's still thinking about what that means.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お弁当の、ポテトサラダ、お友達にも、シェアしてあげようね、翔くん。
lines.en: That's right. Why don't you share some of that potato salad with your friends at lunch, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, gentle redirect. Yumiko hears his delight and gently opens it outward. Her voice is approving, naturally maternal. Soft on his name at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、卵、上手に、茹でられるよ、ママ、見て、できたよ、嬉しい!
lines.en: Mom, I can boil eggs really well now — look, I did it! I'm so happy!
lines.style: Bright burst of pride. Sho's voice lifts on 'I can boil eggs.' Quick, eager delivery — he wants her attention right now. Small laugh of relief at the success. Genuine, unperformed joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 新しいお家、間取り、考えてるのよ、ママ、お父さんと、一緒に、計画中なの。
lines.en: We're thinking about the layout for our new house, you know — your father and I are planning it together.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Yumiko is speaking more to herself than to Sho, sharing a private adult thought. Warm underlying current but her mind is elsewhere. Pace is slower, reflective.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏のスイカ、お祖父ちゃんち、畑で、できるんだよ、ぼく、楽しみだなあ、本当に。
lines.en: The watermelons grow in Grandpa's garden in the summer — I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Gentle enthusiasm. Sho is pulling Yumiko back into his world. Soft wonder at the idea of watermelons. The trailing 'really' is dreamy, not demanding. He's imagining it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの、ありのままの姿、ママ、本当に、大好きよ、いつまでも、応援してるからね。
lines.en: Just the way you are, Sho — I love you so much, exactly as you are. I'll always be cheering for you.
lines.style: Deep tenderness, without performance. Yumiko's voice softens completely. She speaks slowly, deliberately, making sure he hears each piece. Slight catch of emotion but held steady. A mother telling her child something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんの体型、ちょっと、丸くなってきたって、お母さん、言ってたね、ダイエット?
lines.en: Dad's been getting a little rounder, hasn't he? Mom said something about it — is he on a diet?
lines.style: Innocent observation, not mean. Sho is trying out something he heard an adult say, testing if it's okay to mention. Curious, not unkind. Slight questioning lilt at the end — he's not sure if he should have said it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お野菜、嫌う子供、多いって、聞くけど、翔くん、よく、食べてくれて、嬉しいわ。
lines.en: A lot of children don't like vegetables, but I'm so glad you eat yours so well, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, pleased approval. Yumiko is noticing his small goodness and letting him know it matters. Her voice is close, intimate. Pride in him, not for showing off to others, but real recognition.
